Open the Tencent News copy (dated 2024-07-22) and ChinaTalk translation.I found one dated AI prediction from Liang Wenfeng in 2024. It's the one you already have on record (2024-07-22). I found nothing new.

- **The prediction:** In the July 2024 interview with 暗涌 Waves (a 36Kr outlet), he was asked how long until AGI. ChinaTalk's English translation prints his answer as: "It could be two, five, or ten years–in any case, it will happen in our lifetimes." I read that on the ChinaTalk page. I couldn't confirm the original Chinese wording. The Tencent News and Sina copies I opened were cut off before that question, and the WeChat original wouldn't open ("url_not_allowed").
- **Date:** ChinaTalk only says it was "originally published this past July". The Tencent copy carries 36Kr's own posting at 2024-07-22, which matches your file. The publish date of 17 July appeared only in a search result I didn't open, so I've left the date as 2024-07.
- **Rest of the interview:** In the parts I could read, nothing else meets all four tests. "Our ultimate goal is still to achieve AGI" is a goal, not a forecast of when. "Two or three may survive", about China's other AI startups, is a business forecast. The talk about a "two-generation gap" and a "gap of one or two years" describes where things stand now, not the future.
- **Possible gap:** The ChinaTalk text stopped partway through his roadmap answer (that page also wouldn't load in full), so I couldn't check the end of the interview. Someone should read the ChinaTalk page in full to confirm nothing dated comes later.
- **Other years:** The 2023 Waves interview (LessWrong page) has two dated forecasts, listed under other_years. Many later pages about him report a 2025 investor meeting rather than 2024 statements.

I didn't find any other 2024 public talks, podcasts or posts by him.
